tasks.title: Initialize TypeScript & Electron project configuration
tasks.description: Configure package.json, tsconfig.json, build scripts, and dependencies (Electron, @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, zod).
acceptanceCriteria: npm run build compiles TypeScript without errors
Electron boots into empty window test harness

tasks.title: Implement Electron Chromium host window with persistent partition
tasks.description: Render music.youtube.com using partition 'persist:ytmusic' allowing user to authenticate via GUI without Cloud API keys.
acceptanceCriteria: Loads music.youtube.com reliably
Stores auth cookies across app restarts
App window stays responsive without blocking main thread

tasks.title: Implement Cookie Extraction and SAPISID Hash Generator
tasks.description: Extract active session cookies (__Secure-3PAPISID, SAPISID) and generate authorization header for YouTube internal APIs.
acceptanceCriteria: Extracts cookies from session partition
Generates SHA-1 SAPISID hash header for authorized background requests

tasks.title: Implement Playback State Introspection
tasks.description: Query player bar elements to extract isPlaying, track title, artist, album, duration, and elapsed seconds.
acceptanceCriteria: player_get_state returns structured playback snapshot in <= 150ms
Handles paused, buffering, and unstarted player states gracefully

tasks.title: Implement Queue Inspection
tasks.description: Query ytmusic-player-queue items to expose ordered list of played, active, and upcoming tracks.
acceptanceCriteria: queue_inspect returns currentIndex and array of tracks with status tags
Reflects dynamically updated queue without DOM freezing

tasks.title: Implement In-Place Queue Mutation & Navigation
tasks.description: Execute non-disruptive queue insertion (relative offset, append), track removal, and jump-to-index using Polymer store dispatch.
acceptanceCriteria: queue_insert_relative inserts track right next to active song without page reload
queue_append appends tracks to end of queue
queue_jump_to navigates to index without audio stutter

tasks.title: Implement Semantic Search Client
tasks.description: Send search queries to /youtubei/v1/music/search using authenticated session headers and parse song results.
acceptanceCriteria: music_search returns top matches with videoId, title, artist, and duration
Returns empty array or helpful error when query has no matches

tasks.title: Implement Radio Seeds & Watch Next Extraction
tasks.description: Query /youtubei/v1/next endpoint with target videoId to extract YouTube Music co-listening and radio candidates.
acceptanceCriteria: music_get_radio_seeds returns candidate tracks for transition bridging
Deduplicates against active queue items

tasks.title: Implement Embedded MCP SSE Server on Port 4382
tasks.description: Expose all 8 defined MCP tools via Model Context Protocol SDK over SSE endpoint http://127.0.0.1:4382/sse.
acceptanceCriteria: SSE server starts on port 4382 on app boot
Responds to MCP initialize, list_tools, and call_tool requests
Input schemas validated with Zod

tasks.title: Implement Stdio Bridge CLI (ytmusic-mcp-bridge)
tasks.description: Develop zero-dependency CLI wrapper that connects stdio to the local SSE endpoint for Claude Desktop / Cursor compatibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Pipes stdin/stdout transparently to localhost:4382
Provides clear error message if Electron host is not running
